svg.title: redisq Close: a closing consumer hands its unacknowledged jobs back to the front of the list at once and wakes another consumer
svg.desc: Two DistributedQueue consumers with three worker slots each share a queue. At the start the queue and the pending set are empty, consumer C2 is idle and its chip is in the idle set, and consumer C1 has not started yet. Jobs J1, J2 and J3 are enqueued back to back; each enqueue pushes the job to the tail of the list and wakes up to one idle consumer per waiting job in the same script. J1's push takes C2 out of the idle set and publishes to it; J2 and J3 find the idle set empty, so they wake no one. C2 wakes with three free slots and pops J1, J2 and J3, one DequeueWithAckId call per free slot: each pop moves the job from the head of the list into the pending set, tagged with its owner C2 and with a visibility deadline, and C2 runs all three. At its next nudge, once a second, C2 finds the queue empty and puts itself back in the idle set although all its slots are busy. C1 starts and subscribes, which adds it to the idle set too. Then C2 calls Close while its three jobs are still running and unacknowledged. Close first calls leave, which takes C2 out of the idle set. Then one release script pushes C2's pending jobs back to the front of the list in pop order, J1, then J2, then J3, so the list reads J3, J2, J1 from the head, and drops C2's heartbeat and presence. Then it wakes up to three idle consumers: C1 is the only member of the idle set, so C1 alone is woken. C1 pops J3, J2 and J1 right away, one call per free slot, with no timer involved, while C2's process exits: its runs are cut off, an acknowledgment after Close would fail, and the jobs run again on C1. C1's next nudge finds the queue empty and puts it back in the idle set. C1 finishes and acknowledges all three jobs, which deletes their pending entries. At the end the list and the pending set are empty, C1 is idle in the idle set and C2 is gone; the picture then fades back to the start state to replay. Times are not to scale.

g.text: job in Redis: waiting in the list, or pending
consumer in :idle, or owner of a pending job
wake: PUBLISH to one idle consumer
nudge, once a second per consumer

svg.text: visibility timeout (default 5 min) drawn as 16 s
